pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the edges; patches are densely packed on the hindquarters and more widely spaced on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette produced by a short, upright mane along the dorsal line of the neck.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, dark avian-shaped feature (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the neck and shoulder.
